description: Start the Best Of Motivation Personality Colour Quiz (12 questions, about 3 minutes). Use when the user wants to know their personality colour (red, yellow, green or blue), asks for a personality colour or color quiz, or a four colours personality test. Returns the questions and a quiz_key. Ask them one at a time, showing every option exactly as written with its letter, and record the letter the user picks. Do not tell the user which result an option points to and do not guess the result yourself: when all 12 are answered, call score_colour_quiz with the letters and the quiz_key.
name: start_colour_quiz
title: Start the Personality Colour Quiz
